hero.h1: Turn event inquiries into signed, paid bookings — with minimal admin.
hero.sub: Eventeer gives event venues one place to handle every inquiry: personalised proposals, digital signing and payment — all under your own brand. Win back a day of admin every week and spend it where it counts: your clients, and events people never forget.
hero.note: No obligation · Built in Berlin · GDPR in mind

pains.title: Sound familiar?
pains.p1: Every proposal rebuilt from scratch in Word or Excel.
pains.p2: Ten emails back and forth before the client decides.
pains.p3: Deposits chased by hand, sometimes forgotten.
pains.p4: No one place that shows where each event stands.

benefits.title: Everything the offer needs, in one place
benefits.b1_b: Build a personalised offer from your own spaces, packages and extras.
benefits.b2_b: Minimum spends, seasons, weekdays and service charges are applied for you.
benefits.b3_b: Send one link and the client configures their event within the limits you set.
benefits.b4_t: Signed and paid in one flow
benefits.b4_b: Contract, deposit and reminders follow the offer automatically.
benefits.b5_b: See every deal's stage at a glance and share a read-only view with your team.
benefits.b6_b: Your logo and colours on everything the client sees.

how.title: How it works
how.s1_b: Requests land in one inbox — from your form, your inbox or added by hand.
how.s2_b: Pick spaces, packages and extras; pricing rules do the maths.
how.s3_b: The client configures and accepts the offer, then signs digitally.
how.s4_b: Deposit and reminders run automatically; the kitchen and floor get their brief.

pricing.title: Early access
pricing.body: Eventeer is in early access. Start with 30 days free. Founding customers get preferential pricing when we launch — no card needed to try.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I have to replace my current CRM?
faq.a1: No. Start with proposals and contracts; keep whatever else you use.
faq.a2: You add your spaces, packages and prices once. Most venues are set up within an hour.
faq.q3: What happens to my client data?
faq.a3: It stays in your own company account with role-based access for your team. You can export or delete it at any time.
faq.a4: The app and your client-facing documents work in English and German.
faq.a5: Early access is free for 30 days. Book a demo and we'll talk about founding-customer pricing.
